data_method: CPUC DGStats Interconnected Applications zip (downloaded 2026-09-23, data through 2026-05-31; PG&E Jan2020-May2026, SCE Jan2020-May2026, SDG&E Historical-May2026 files). Filter: Technology Type contains 'Photovoltaic', Application Status 'Interconnected', App Approved Date in 2025; non-residential = Customer Sector in {Commercial, Industrial, Educational, Non-Profit, Other Government, Military} (3,607 systems). Watts/module = System Size DC*1000 / sum(Generator Quantity 1..11), kept if 150-800 W. CEC PV Module List full data ('Data has not changed since September 21, 2026'), non-BIPV, CEC Listing Date 2025-09-21..2026-09-21 (1,651 models); efficiency = Pmax/(A_c*1000).
